date_cutoff_reason: Pre-specified calendar boundary before Qwen2.5 late-September submissions; coverage check only, no model-performance metrics inspected before sealing.

main_comparable_cohort.definition: Exact C8-R1 complete-six-task model matched to C5 High (same model, same validation set; Pythia final checkpoint D=299.893B).
main_comparable_cohort.pooling_rule: Only records with this exact loss definition are pooled into the main bridge.

c6_role: C6 High duplicates the C5 rows and is not independent. C6 Medium is restricted to stratified/source-transfer analysis because its loss definitions are not comparable.

identity_rules.bridge_join: Exact raw Model string; no fuzzy merge for bridge eligibility.
identity_rules.canonicalization: Aliases are descriptive only; normalized matches cannot confer bridge eligibility.
identity_rules.duplicate_directory_rule: Distinct interpretable evaluation timestamps: retain latest and report the other run. No reliable temporal ordering: retain all runs under the same canonical model group and never split them.

c8_rules.target_scale: six task scores multiplied by 100 to match leaderboard units; mean is auxiliary

missing_data_rules.log_D_models: only records with observed D_tokens_B are eligible for logD models

candidate_selection.method: grouped internal cross-validation by canonical model ID
candidate_selection.rule: one-standard-error preference for the simplest candidate whose mean RMSE is within one standard error of the best valid internal RMSE

validation.internal: 5-fold group cross-validation by model ID; duplicate runs remain in one group
validation.time: train Submission Date < 2024-09-01; test Submission Date >= 2024-09-01
validation.family: leave one family out when both train and test have at least 3 models; otherwise OOS only
validation.scale: train below 20B parameters; test >=20B; size strata <=3B, >3B to <20B, >=20B
validation.source_transfer: train C5 High, test C6 Medium excluding any same-model overlap; label source-transfer, never holdout

identifiability_rule: IDENTIFIED_PREDICTIVE_BRIDGE only if all frozen thresholds pass in internal, time-out, and leave-family validation for the same main direction. Otherwise CONDITIONAL_ASSOCIATION_ONLY unless identity or loss alignment fails, in which case NOT_IDENTIFIABLE.
no_causality_rule: Correlations and residual associations are not labeled causal technological progress.
